stem: Two transplants are the same age, but one is root-bound and stressed while the other is well established. What is the strongest transplant-timing principle?
choices: Evaluate root condition and plant readiness rather than treating age alone as the decision rule
Transplant both because age is identical
Transplant the stressed plant first to force recovery
Ignore root condition if the calendar date is correct
rationale: Age is only one planning cue; root condition and acclimation determine whether a transplant is ready for field conditions.
